title: Supply Chain Priority Reallocation
core_conflict: An old supplier schedule says the shipment is ready, while newer carrier and warehouse evidence show a partial shortage requiring priority reallocation.
required_constraints: include contradictory supplier schedules, carrier notes, and warehouse evidence
include workspace files, logistics emails, task-board allocation blockers, and delivery calendar windows
include dynamic updates that change shortage count, ETA, or allocation priority after early rounds
emphasize priority updates, task-board repair, and conflicting ETA reconciliation
